I couldn't compile this offline, so my change is unverified. Maven can't resolve the formatter plugin without network access, and skipping the formatter and import-sort plugins didn't help. I never reproduced the issue either, and I'm not certain my change fixes the reporter's case.

I changed `ClientSendRequestHandler` in `independent-projects/resteasy-reactive/client/runtime`. When the request body is an `InputStream` and a writer interceptor is registered, the client skips its streaming path. It then fully reads the stream while preparing the body on the Vert.x event loop. If that stream blocks, for example a request-scoped stream from the caller, you get `BlockingOperationNotAllowedException`.

My fix prepares the body on a worker thread in that case. It does this through `Context.executeBlocking`, and only when the call is on an event-loop thread. Afterwards it sends the request exactly as the existing code did.

The reporter's repository wasn't available, so I'm guessing at their setup. The existing streaming upload path already reads on a worker, so the exception could come from a different path.

I didn't run any tests. I also didn't use the axiomengine graph, because none was built for this repo, so I fell back to grep and read.
